name: Hans Christian Ørsted
contribution: A Danish chemist and physicist who discovered that electric currents create magnetic fields.
legacy: The centimetre-gram-second system unit of magnetic induction is named for his contributions to the field of electromagnetism.

checks.lead: Hans Christian Ørsted (Danish: [ˈɶɐ̯steð] ; 14 August 1777 – 9 March 1851), sometimes transliterated as Oersted ( UR-sted), was a Danish chemist and physicist who discovered that electric currents create magnetic fields. This phenomenon is known as Oersted's law. He also discovered aluminium, a chemical element.
